title: Part 3 : 2021: General classification of lubricants industrial oils and related products Part 3 Family F Spindle bearings bearings and associated clutches
clause_1_scope: This Indian standard (Part 3) prescribes a detailed classification of family F (spindle bearings, bearings and associated clutches) for lubricants, industrial oils and related products (Class L) covered under IS 11159 (Part 1).

clause_2_normative_references.title: Part 1 : 2020: General Classification of Lubricants, Industrial Oils and Related Products Part 1 Class L ( First Revision )
Viscosity Classification For Industrial Liquid Lubricants ( First Revision )

clause_3_terminology: Part 3 : 2021: General classification of lubricants industrial oils and related products Part 3 Family F Spindle bearings bearings and associated clutches

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
